title: Supercongruences for Domb numbers
summary: We prove two supercongruence statements proposed by Z.-W. Sun for Domb numbers. The first concerns the unweighted truncated sum $$S_p=\sum_{n=0}^{p-1}D_n$$ and is governed by the two proper ideal classes of the order of discriminant $-60$ in $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-15})$. We prove Sun's conjectured congruences modulo $p^2$ and obtain stronger formulas modulo $p^3$ in the split cases. The second concerns Domb sums weighted by the Lucas sequences associated with $X^2-11X+1$.
